Moss's 30 September strategic digest says Mateo submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14. I've replied in our DM with the same answer and a warning about the number.

The digest describes drivers unable to select Dock Door 14 on the Newark check-in kiosk during second shift. It also says you escalated the ticket to platform engineering.

Check #8841 before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed #8841 with support, and that one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk tablet cache issue. That looks like a different problem. I can't see the ticket records, so I can't tell whether the digest reused the number by mistake. Please confirm it in the support system or with Mateo.
